title: Howard Hughes visiting George Van Tassel at Giant Rock

tellings.quote: George Van Tassel used to have Howard Hughes land on his private airirstrip and come eat his wife's ties.

plain: In the 1950s a man named George Van Tassel lived at Giant Rock, a huge boulder in the California desert, where he kept a private airstrip. A researcher and philosopher, Jason Jorjani, says on a podcast that Howard Hughes, the famous American flyer and businessman, used to land on that airstrip and come eat food Van Tassel's wife made, crediting a work called Closer Encounters. If true, it would tie one of the richest men in aviation to a desert spot later linked with UFO stories.
